tickets.approver_reason: Michael Cervantes (E025) requested admin access to Source Code, which is owned by the Engineer role. The two team notes conflict on his employment status: one lists him as full-time Analyst (max write, since Analyst does not own Source Code, so admin not permitted), while the other lists him as contractor with basic security training (max read, since write requires advanced training and admin is never allowed). Under both interpretations, the requested admin level exceeds the maximum. Granting read is at or below the maximum under both the full-time (write) and contractor (read) interpretations, is never more than requested, and is the conservative level given the conflicting facts. Decision: read.

Security DB (Note 3, ticket 2) confirms Michael Cervantes is a contractor with basic security training. Per policy, contractors without advanced security training max out at read access. The requested write is above the maximum, so the maximum of read is granted.
